data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin name Anna, which means grace or favor. In the Greek language, Anna is derived from the word ana, meaning grace or divine favor. The name Nanci is a diminutive form of Anna and carries the same graceful and delightful meaning. The name Nanci carries the meaning “Grace, delight” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nanci usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
